items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Like the first trumpet had such a sound, Big Jim Lawson, he was terrific.

ctx.x: They worked a lot of white dates?

Yes, they did more white dates than anything else. Then when we first began to hit in the 30's everyone thought Andy was white because they had never seen a picture of him, because the band sounded like it on some things that we played. He believed in phrasing ballads in a very beautiful way, like violins. This band, they had a way of getting arrangements and things on the spot.
